\fcnotes{The projected residuals alone do not prove Gate~4: raising premises and saturation ranks are also used. Gate~5 and its positive-mode consequences are derived; the value $\dim U_4=6010$ is not an input. Every finite input is listed with its record in the certificate ledger (App.~M) and its fresh replay in \S M.1.}
